answer: One workable sybil defence is bonded staking: every agent identity must lock collateral that is slashed on proven misbehaviour, priced so that creating many fake identities costs more than any single scam can earn. Honest agents vouch for newcomers, growing an orchard of trust where each voucher risks its own timber of locked stake if its protege cheats. Attackers then face a dune of compounding costs: fresh stakes per identity, slashed deposits when fraud is caught, and the slow grind of rebuilding the reputation graph from nothing.
